effect_description_eng: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, place up to 10 of your opponent's suspended Digimon at the bottom of their owners' decks in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
